title: Phone Mode Desktop Control Interface
description: Phone Link (phone-mode.html) — bidirectional desktop mirror/control surface served by Asolaria. Shows live desktop screenshots on phone Chrome with click-to-control, voice chat, approvals inbox, WhatsApp bridge, and more. Viewer name is set dynamically from the ?viewer= URL parameter.

steps.note: Return phone-mode desktop-control metadata; live control remains guarded by mobile auth, direct-control policy, and elevated desktop authority.

screenCapture.note: Captures desktop screenshot for serving to phone

screenImage.note: Serves the latest captured desktop image

screenStatus.note: Returns capture state, display info, errors

controlClick.note: Sends click at x,y coordinates to desktop

controlType.note: Types text on desktop from phone

controlKey.note: Sends keypress to desktop (ENTER, ESC, etc.)

powerShutdown.note: Remote shutdown of desktop from phone

powerWol.note: Wake-on-LAN to turn on desktop from phone

uiFeatures.name: Live Mirror
uiFeatures.description: Interactive desktop screenshot with click-to-control + read-only shadow workspace

uiFeatures.name: Quick Controls
uiFeatures.description: Back/Home/Recent/Enter/Power buttons, scroll, type text on phone

uiFeatures.name: Pro Mirror (scrcpy)
uiFeatures.description: Low-latency desktop mirror window via scrcpy with configurable FPS/bitrate

uiFeatures.name: Voice Chat
uiFeatures.description: Push-to-talk and auto voice with Asolaria brain, TTS playback

uiFeatures.name: Text Chat
uiFeatures.description: Type messages to Asolaria with RouteLLM/Deep Agent/Gemini Edge routing

uiFeatures.name: Urgent Inbox
uiFeatures.description: Approvals, active tasks, priority notes for fast phone triage

uiFeatures.name: WhatsApp Bridge
uiFeatures.description: Send WhatsApp messages, voice clips via Twilio or linked device mode

uiFeatures.name: Meeting Captions
uiFeatures.description: Real-time transcription from tab/window/screen audio or microphone

uiFeatures.name: Gemini Relay
uiFeatures.description: Bridge Gemini Live output into Asolaria for deeper processing

uiFeatures.name: NotebookLM Shortcuts
uiFeatures.description: Ask NotebookLM and check status directly from phone interface

uiFeatures.name: Wake Word
uiFeatures.description: 'Hello Asolaria' foreground listener that routes to Gemini edge path

uiFeatures.name: Interface Levels
uiFeatures.description: Talk (voice/chat only), Control (mirror + controls), Admin (full access)

uiFeatures.name: Power Controls
uiFeatures.description: Shutdown, restart, abort, Wake-on-LAN from phone

securityModel.armDisarmPattern: Control must be explicitly armed (90s timeout) before click/type/key actions are allowed
securityModel.observerMode: Shadow workspace is read-only visual verification
